title: Cashier System
tagline: POS-style cashier and inventory system with MSSQL backend
intro: A robust cashier and inventory system built with C#, WPF, and MSSQL, featuring role-based access for admins and cashiers.
summary: Developed as a university project, this Windows desktop app handled real-time cashier operations, inventory management, and order history tracking. MSSQL backend ensured structured storage, while WPF delivered a responsive POS interface.
features: Role-based authorization for Admin and Cashier
Inventory management with auto stock tracking
MSSQL backend for structured transaction data

sections.title: Description
sections.body: Cashier system with inventory, order history, and role-based access for admins and cashiers.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Provide a secure, reliable POS-style cashier and inventory system for multi-user environments.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Designed DB schema, implemented authorization, inventory, and transaction flows, and built WPF interface.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Delivered a robust, real-world-ready POS solution showcasing SQL integration and role-based workflows.
